title: Sr. Manager Data Governance
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Lead enterprise data governance, establishing data policies, stewardship frameworks, and master data 'Golden Record' standards, and enforcing data compliance, access controls, and data lineage across the Group's GCP and SAP data architectures.

* Establish and maintain enterprise data policies, standards, and data stewardship frameworks across the Group.
* Define and enforce master data 'Golden Record' standards and master data management (MDM) practices across GCP and SAP architectures (SAP MDM), including reference data and the business glossary.
* Enforce data compliance and privacy (PDPL, GDPR), including access controls, role-based access (Looker RBAC), and security classification.

* Own data cataloging and data lineage using UpGuard, ensuring end-to-end traceability across data platforms.
* Establish data quality governance standards, defining quality dimensions (freshness, completeness, validity, schema drift), quality SLAs, and scorecards, with oversight of automated and AI-assisted data quality monitoring.
* Define onboarding playbooks for new data sources, data products, and BI assets, with clear ownership, certification, and quality gates.
* Set governance standards for data documentation (dbt Cloud Docs) and metadata across Google BigQuery and the wider data estate.
* Partner with business, IT, and security teams to operationalize data governance, drive adoption, and report on compliance, quality coverage, and adoption metrics to leadership.
* Mentor and guide data governance and quality practitioners, growing governance capability across the function.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in data governance, data management, or enterprise data quality, including leading governance initiatives.

* Deep expertise in data governance frameworks, data stewardship, business glossary, reference data, and master data management (Golden Record standards, SAP MDM).
* Strong knowledge of data compliance and privacy regulations (PDPL, GDPR), access controls, security classification, and data lineage.
* Experience defining data quality dimensions, quality SLAs, scorecards, and stewardship and onboarding playbooks.
* Hands-on experience with data cataloging and lineage tooling (UpGuard), Looker RBAC, and documentation (dbt Cloud Docs).
* Proficiency in SQL and Google BigQuery, with experience governing data across GCP and SAP architectures.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

3. Strong data management skills. Experienced in data cleanup, deduplication, field mapping, and data governance.

4. Proven experience designing lead scoring, lead routing, and lifecycle stages in partnership with sales.

5. Skilled at building reports and dashboards in Salesforce, GA4, or BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and at documenting processes clearly.

title: SEO Executive
description:

1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

* Perform keyword research and identify high-intent keywords for software development and B2B services.
* Optimize website pages, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and internal links.
* Implement on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.
* Improve organic rankings, website traffic, and search visibility.
* Conduct competitor analysis and identify new keyword opportunities.

2. Technical SEO

* Conduct regular website SEO audits and identify technical issues.
* Monitor indexing, crawling, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, and redirects.
* Improve website performance, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and site structure.
* Implement and validate structured data and schema markup.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve technical SEO issues.

3. Content SEO

* Develop SEO-friendly content plans for service pages, blogs, landing pages, and case studies.
* Work with content writers and designers to create optimized website content.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve existing pages.
* Ensure content meets search intent and supports business objectives.

4. AEO and GEO Optimization

* Optimize content to answer user questions and improve eligibility for featured snippets and answer-based search results.
* Improve brand visibility and discoverability across AI-powered search platforms.
* Create FAQ content, comparison pages, informative articles, and authoritative service content.
* Monitor brand mentions and available referral or visibility data from AI-driven platforms.

5. Off-Page SEO and Link Building

* Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through ethical SEO practices.
* Identify industry directories, business listings, guest-posting opportunities, and relevant partnerships.
* Monitor backlink quality and online brand reputation.

6. B2B Lead Generation

* Optimize service pages and landing pages to attract potential business clients.
* Identify keywords related to software development, web applications, mobile applications, and other company services.
* Improve website conversion opportunities through effective calls to action.
* Collaborate with the digital marketing team on content marketing and LinkedIn visibility.
* Align SEO activities with qualified inquiries and business growth.

7. Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and relevant SEO tools.
* Track keyword visibility, organic traffic, indexed pages, conversions, and leads.
* Prepare weekly progress updates and monthly SEO reports.
* Maintain an SEO action plan with task owners, priorities, deadlines, and completion status.
* Recommend improvements based on data and measurable results.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
* Practical understanding of keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Familiarity with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
* Understanding of WordPress or other content management systems.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and schema markup.
* Good writing, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of AEO and GEO is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Improvement in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings.
* Growth in qualified organic website traffic.
* Technical SEO issues identified and resolved.
* Growth in relevant, quality backlinks and referring domains.
* SEO content published and existing pages optimized.
* Improvement in qualified inquiries and organic lead conversions.
* Increased brand visibility across search engines and AI-powered platforms.
* Timely completion of assigned tasks and monthly reports.

Preferred Candidate Profile

title: AI-First Marketing Lead (m/w/d) - Remote
description:
refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.

The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.

**Tasks**
---------

* **Content quality and brand voice:** Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.
* **AI content engine:** Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.
* **Account-based marketing support:** Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.
* **SEO and inbound:** Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.
* **Brand and thought leadership:** Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.
* **Events and field:** Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.
* **Partner co-marketing:** Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.
* You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.
* Fluent, flawless native spokend and written english
* Agentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have **it is how this role operates day to day.**
* Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.
* Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.
* Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.
* HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.
* Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.
* One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.

**Benefits**
------------

* End-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth path
* The chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problem
* Attractive compensation package and options after year 1
* Training budget and access to the latest AI tooling
* Direct access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day one
* Work from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connection

We use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.

To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.

* Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.
* Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think.

* Present performance read-outs and optimisation recommendations to client marketing and business leadership.

* Manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks and client expectations across marketing, sales, service, data, technology and compliance stakeholders.
* **Business Development Support:**

title: Manager II, Science, Tech - Science

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues.

  

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE**

  

* **Communication, Collaboration & Leadership** : Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others.
* **Knowledge** : Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees.
* **Metrics** : Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
* **Quality Standards** : Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks.
* **Test Strategy & Planning** : Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases.
* **Test Execution** : Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes.
* **Mentorship** : Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team.

**YOU ARE**

* **Genuinely curious — you ask why, not just whether.** You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around.
* **Shift-left by default.** You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor — spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first.
* **A master of async defect communication.** You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to — self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation.
* **Globally minded** , with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US–India collaboration genuinely cohesive — and you've built those habits in practice.
* **Methodical and detail-oriented** — you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file.
* **A collaborative teammate** , comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane — you go where quality needs attention.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 4+ years’ experience
* Proficiency with **Postman** for API testing — structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification.

Experience with the **Adobe Experience Platform Debugger** or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills — including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call.  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **Adobe Analytics** validation — understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR).
